name: Hair dryers

comps.spec: Small 12–24V DC motor fed through a diode bridge from a tap on the heater — runs from a battery once removed
comps.loc: Behind the fan at the back

comps.spec: Nichrome ribbon on mica cards, about 1,000–1,800W — spare nichrome for hot-wire cutting
Bridge rectifier or four diodes feeding the motor
Bimetal cutoff and one-shot thermal fuse
comps.loc: In the barrel beside the element

notes: Professional and newer high-speed dryers may use AC or brushless motors instead of the small DC motor.

sources.title: Open Repair Alliance, Open Repair Data v0.3 (community repair events, 2012 to July 2026; CC BY-SA 4.0): 4,467 repairs recorded as Hair dryer
